_what: THE GAIN TABLE for the whole-rig exact-application path: what a commanded DNA vertex delta actually delivers at the RENDERED landmark, per (region x mask). Attenuation is a property of the PAIR, never of the region alone.
_measured: 2026-08-19, scratch duplicates, locked camera (distance_cm 84.087153, bit-identical across an editor restart), cm/px 0.017454, landmark measures at FIXED scale.
_how_to_use: command_cm = wanted_render_cm / ratio. For MIRRORED width regions the command is PER SIDE and the wanted figure is the WIDTH, so command_per_side = wanted_width / (2 * ratio).

jaw_width._depth_note: CHAINING RAISED DELIVERY, 0.58 -> 0.70. There is no depth penalty in the measured range; the two numbers bracket the mask's own variability.

cheek_width._note: inside the deadband against the reference, so it does not need a gain to fit

mask_delivery_is_positional._what: The same mask delivers different fractions at different places, so a ratio is only meaningful for the LANDMARK it was measured at.
mask_delivery_is_positional._source: read_dna_meshes bounds, wholerig_chin_down2cm.dna vs depth2_chin_jaw.dna -- a DIFFERENT REPRESENTATION from the render (the DNA on disk).

fit_path_comparators._note: the parametric path OVER-delivers where whole-rig lands near 1:1, and its reproducibility collapses at edited states (0.27 cm floor vs 0.056 cm).

residual_vs_reference._reference: hero/reference/hero_face_bald_frontal.jpg (the SHAPE target; hero_example_pic.jpg is APPEARANCE ONLY)
residual_vs_reference._signs: delta = target - current. chin negative = chin must go LOWER; jaw negative = jaw must NARROW.
